passages.text: Kestrel Peak is a dormant volcano in the Ardenne Range. Its summit reaches 3,310 meters above sea level, making it the second-highest peak in the range.
The Kestrel rover landed in Marrow Valley in 2031. It carries a 12-kilogram drill and a 450-meter range radar.
The Halcyon cell stores 480 watt-hours per kilogram. A full recharge takes 38 minutes at standard rates.
The Vireo protocol uses 256-bit keys and rotates them every 72 hours. It was standardized in 2019.
Bluefern Lake covers 88 square kilometers and reaches a depth of 214 meters. Its water is mildly alkaline.
Tern-9 is a weather satellite launched in 2018. It orbits at an altitude of 620 kilometers and relays data every 90 minutes.
Ostrich Roasters was founded in 1997 in Piedmont. The roastery produces 40 tons of coffee per year.
The Sable Bridge spans 1,250 meters across the Rover River. It opened in 1987 and carries four lanes of traffic.
Ferrite samples from the Kestrel drill core contain 14 percent iron. The samples were collected at a depth of 60 meters.
Prevailing winds over Marrow Valley blow from the north-west at 24 kilometers per hour during summer.
